# GitHub Discovery

> GitHub Discovery is a daily GitHub repository discovery pipeline that surfaces projects while they are still accelerating, for developers who want early signal instead of yesterday's popularity.

GitHub Trending ranks what is already popular today, which means you meet a project after everyone else has. GitHub Discovery collects candidates from six sources every day, scores each one out of 100 (acceleration 40 / quality 30 / anti-spam 30, plus a code-quality bonus of up to 20 and penalties for suspicious or batch star growth), drops anything already recommended in the previous 7 days, and publishes the top 10 as a web page, an Atom feed and an email digest. The six sources are GitHub Trending, GitHub Search for repositories created in the last 7 days, Hacker News Show HN posts, a fork-growth "rising" pass over repositories created in the last 3 days, a rotating AI/ML keyword sweep over GitHub Search, and Hugging Face Daily Papers. It runs entirely on GitHub Actions with no server: fork the repository, set the `RESEND_API_KEY` secret, enable the workflow. Locally: `python scripts/main.py`.

## Docs
- [Daily picks](https://alloevil.github.io/github-discovery/): today's ranked repositories with their scores, filterable by date and language
- [Atom feed](https://alloevil.github.io/github-discovery/feed.xml): the last ~14 days of picks, regenerated on every run
- [Roadmap](https://alloevil.github.io/github-discovery/ROADMAP.md): planned work
- [README](https://github.com/alloevil/github-discovery#readme): the source list, the scoring dimensions and the setup steps

## Evidence
- [claims.json](https://alloevil.github.io/github-discovery/claims.json): the numbers below in machine-readable form, each with its repro command
- [Backtest report](https://github.com/alloevil/github-discovery/blob/main/reports/verify-2026-06-25.json): 13 of the 20 repositories in the 7-day sample gained at least 10% more stars after being recommended (precision 0.65); average star growth over that window was 18.71%
- [Daily result data](https://github.com/alloevil/github-discovery/tree/main/data): every day's scored output committed as JSON — this is what the backtest reads, so the numbers can be recomputed from a fresh clone
- [Scoring code](https://github.com/alloevil/github-discovery/blob/main/scripts/scorer.py): the dimension limits are constants in `scripts/config.py`, not prose
